defs.d: A sketch or account of anything in words; a portraiture or representation in language; an enumeration of the essential qualities of a thing or species.
The act of describing; a delineation by marks or signs.
A person who has not yet reached adulthood, whether natural (puberty), cultural (initiation), or legal (majority)
defs.ex: Go easy on him: he is but a child.

defs.d: (specifically) A female child, a girl.
A child of noble birth.
The cognomen given to the oldest son prior to his taking his father's title.

A website that allows users to reflect, share opinions, and discuss various topics in the form of an online journal, sometimes letting readers comment on their posts. Most blogs are written in a slightly informal tone (personal journals, news, businesses, etc.)
An individual post to a blog.
defs.ex: This blog was originally posted on my personal site but is reproduced on the forums for greater visibility.

defs.d: To contribute to a blog.
A gathering of people for the purchase and sale of merchandise at a set time, often periodic.
defs.ex: The privilege to hold a weekly market was invaluable for any feudal era burgh.

defs.d: City square or other fairly spacious site where traders set up stalls and buyers browse the merchandise.
To make (products or services) available for sale and promote them.
defs.ex: We plan to market an ecology model by next quarter.

defs.d: To sell
defs.ex: We marketed more this quarter already than all last year!

defs.d: A married person.
In a state of marriage; having a wife or a husband.
Showing commitment or devotion normally reserved for a spouse
defs.ex: married to one's work.

defs.d: To enter into the conjugal or connubial state; to take a husband or a wife.
defs.ex: Neither of her daughters showed any desire to marry.

defs.d: (in passive) To be joined to (someone) as spouse according to law or custom.
defs.ex: His daughter was married some five years ago to a tailor's apprentice.

defs.d: Something additional, such as an item above and beyond the ordinary school curriculum, or added to the usual charge on a bill.
An extra edition of a newspaper, which is printed outside of the normal printing cycle.
defs.ex: Extra, extra! Read all about it!

defs.d: Beyond what is due, usual, expected, or necessary; extraneous; additional; supernumerary.
defs.ex: I don't mind doing some extra work, as long as I get extra pay.

defs.d: Extraordinarily good; superior.
To an extraordinary degree.
defs.ex: That day he ran to school extra fast.

defs.d: A fourth part of something.
Place or position.
To divide into quarters; to divide by four.
To provide housing for military personnel or other equipment.
defs.ex: Quarter the horses in the third stable.

defs.d: Pertaining to an aspect of a quarter.
Consisting of a fourth part, a quarter (1/4, 25%).
defs.ex: a quarter hour; a quarter century; a quarter note; a quarter pound

defs.d: An advertisement by which individuals attempt to meet others with similar interests.
A movable; a chattel.
Pertaining to human beings as distinct from things.
Of or pertaining to a particular person; relating to, or affecting, an individual, or each of many individuals; peculiar or proper to private concerns; not public or general
defs.ex: Her song was her personal look at the values of friendship.

defs.d: A pass entitling the holder to admission to a show, concert, etc.
A pass entitling the holder to board a train, a bus, a plane, or other means of transportation
To issue someone a ticket, as for travel or for a violation of a local or traffic law.
To mark with a ticket.
defs.ex: to ticket goods in a retail store

defs.d: Graphism of symbols such as letters that express some meaning.
Something written, such as a document, article or book.
A small piece broken from a larger piece of solid material.
A damaged area of a surface where a small piece has been broken off.
defs.ex: This cup has a chip in it.

defs.d: Having excelled, having surpassed.
Of higher or the highest quality; splendid.
Excellently.
To fail to agree; to have a different opinion or belief.
defs.ex: Bob says cats are friendlier than dogs, but I disagree.

defs.d: To fail to conform or correspond with.
defs.ex: My results in the laboratory consistently disagree with yours.

defs.d: A land area free of woodland, cities, and towns; open country.
defs.ex: There are several species of wild flowers growing in this field.

defs.d: A wide, open space that is usually used to grow crops or to hold farm animals.
defs.ex: A crop circle was made in a corn field.

defs.d: To intercept or catch (a ball) and play it.
(and other batting sports) To be the team catching and throwing the ball, as opposed to hitting it.
defs.ex: The blue team are fielding first, while the reds are batting.

defs.d: Any considerable and connected part of a space or surface; specifically, a tract of land or sea of considerable but indefinite extent; a country; a district; in a broad sense, a place without special reference to location or extent but viewed as an entity for geographical, social or cultural reasons.
defs.ex: the equatorial regions

defs.d: An administrative subdivision of a city, a territory, a country.
Each of the seven major bodies which move relative to the fixed stars in the night sky—the Moon, Mercury, Venus, the Sun, Mars, Jupiter and Saturn.

A body which orbits the Sun directly and is massive enough to be in hydrostatic equilibrium (effectively meaning a spheroid) and to dominate its orbit; specifically, the eight major bodies of Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune. (Pluto was considered a planet until 2006 and has now been reclassified as a dwarf planet.)
One who researches.
To stop (an outcome); to keep from (doing something).
defs.ex: I brush my teeth regularly to prevent them from turning yellow.

defs.d: To take preventative measures.
Liquid fat.
Petroleum-based liquid used as fuel or lubricant.
The quality of being varied; diversity.
defs.ex: Variety is the spice of life.

defs.d: A specific variation of something.
The position of the body or way of carrying oneself.
defs.ex: The ballet dancer walked with a graceful attitude.

defs.d: Disposition or state of mind.
defs.ex: Don't give me your negative attitude.

defs.d: To assume or to place in a particular position or orientation; to pose.
To express an attitude through one's posture, bearing, tone of voice, etc.
In an absolute or unconditional manner; utterly, positively, wholly.
Independently; viewed without relation to other things or factors.
Yes; certainly; expression indicating strong agreement.
defs.ex:
Do you want a free cookie with that coffee?
Absolutely!

defs.d: To deliberately not listen or pay attention to.
defs.ex: A problem ignored is a problem doubled.

defs.d: To pretend to not notice someone or something.

A fragment of a human expression that is repeated by somebody else. Most often a quotation is taken from literature or speech, but also scenes from a movie, elements of a painting, a passage of music, etc., may be quoted.
defs.ex: "Where they burn books, they will also burn people" is a famous quotation from Heinrich Heine.

defs.d: A price that has been quoted for buying or selling.
defs.ex: Let's get a quotation for repairing the roof before we decide whether it's worth doing.

defs.d: A small child; an infant.
Anything very small.
Very small.
Worthy, decent, sure of being accepted or received with at least moderate pleasure
defs.ex: We need to find an acceptable present for Jeff.

defs.d: Barely worthy, less than excellent; passable.
defs.ex: The designs were acceptable, but they were nothing special either.

defs.d: The act or state of expecting or looking forward to an event as about to happen.
That which is expected or looked for.
The act of conveying something.
defs.ex: The delivery was completed by four.

defs.d: The item which has been conveyed.
defs.ex: Your delivery is on the table.

defs.d: Of unknown origin.
defs.ex: He received a mysterious phone call this morning.

defs.d: Having unknown qualities.
defs.ex: Our boss is a mysterious man who hardly ever meets with us.

defs.d: A place other than here.
In or at some other place.
To some other place.
(manner) In this way or manner.
defs.ex: If you throw the ball thus, as I’m showing you, you’ll have better luck hitting the target.

defs.d: As a result.
defs.ex: I have all the tools I need; thus, I will be able to fix the car without having to call a mechanic.

defs.d: A paragraph or section of text or music with particular meaning.
defs.ex: She struggled to play the difficult passages.

defs.d: Part of a path or journey.
defs.ex: He made his passage through the trees carefully, mindful of the stickers.

defs.d: To pass something, such as a pathogen or stem cell, through a host or medium
defs.ex: After 24 hours, the culture was passaged to an agar plate.

defs.d: To make a passage, especially by sea; to cross
defs.ex: They passaged to America in 1902.

defs.d: Describing a bird that has left the nest, is living on its own, but is less than a year old. (commonly used in falconry)
defs.ex: Passage red-tailed hawks are preferred by falconers because these younger birds have not yet developed the adult behaviors which would make them more difficult to train.

defs.d: Commendation; favourable representation in words
Worship
To give praise to; to commend, glorify, or worship.
defs.ex: Be sure to praise Bobby for his excellent work at school this week.

defs.d: A single action of sweeping.
defs.ex: Give the front steps a quick sweep to get rid of those fallen leaves.

defs.d: The person who steers a dragon boat.
To clean (a surface) by means of a stroking motion of a broom or brush.
defs.ex: to sweep a floor, the street, or a chimney

defs.d: To move through a (horizontal) arc or similar long stroke.
defs.ex: The offended countess swept out of the ballroom.

defs.d: To follow urgently, originally with intent to capture or harm; to chase.
To follow, travel down (a particular way, course of action etc.).
defs.ex: Her rival pursued a quite different course.
